title: The Enshittification of Everyday Life
summary: The apps promising easier access across health care, insurance, and telecomms have been a giant bait-and-switch. Digital convenience turns out to be little more than the degradation of institutional capacity and the transfer of work onto customers.
reason: This is a textbook example of the capture sequence in action — platforms first route value through convenience, then extract by offloading labor onto users while degrading the substrate they depend on.
angle: Use 'routing architecture' to show how digital platforms don't just change the interface but restructure who does work and where value flows, combined with 'fatal strategy' as the enshittification cycle becomes visible as self-parody.

title: Amazon Is Ratcheting Up Its Fight With NYC Delivery Drivers
summary: Amazon is warning New Yorkers that a bill making it easier for delivery drivers to unionize will cost jobs and raise prices. The company has already put hundreds of drivers out of work by cutting ties with its contractors.
reason: Amazon's threat that unionization will cost jobs—while already cutting jobs preemptively—is a textbook alibi structure becoming visible: the company requires you to believe its retaliation is market logic, not coercion.
angle: Use the alibi structure tool: the 'jobs and prices' argument is the alibi that makes union-busting legible as consumer protection, and Amazon is inadvertently exposing it by enacting the punishment before the bill passes.

title: A Nobel Prize for Being Wrong
summary: Handing Michael Woodford and Robert Hall the Nobel Prize for Economics, the awarding committee said their work had helped deal with shocks. In truth, their models fed the illusion of stability that blinded policymakers to the looming 2008 crisis.
reason: This story shows the alibi structure of mainstream macroeconomics in operation — DSGE models provided the legitimating fiction that made the pre-2008 system legible and self-confident, and the Nobel committee is now reinforcing that alibi rather than questioning it.
angle: Use alibi structure: the prize-giving reveals how academic credentialing launders the epistemic failures of centralized economic modeling, making visible the mechanism by which distributed warning signals (from heterodox economists, community lenders, labor organizers) were systematically discarded.
